definitions.full: H1434. gedil גְּדִלִים noun [masculine] plural twisted threads (Late Hebrew גְּדִיל , Babylonian gidlu , cord on which onions were strung, a string of onions, Zehnpf BAS i. 511 ; Aramaic גְּדִילָא , thread, cord, rope , also plaited locks , id. ) — 1 tassels Deut 22:12 on border of garment (|| צִיצִת Num 15:38-39 ,). 2 festoons , on capitals of columns 1Kin 7:17 .
